review.basis: Spec 04 sections 2.3, 3.2 and 4.2; DeviceEvent values from cb-ground's M1 on the 14 server reports. Written by a build job: applied at once and shown as not yet confirmed until a person confirms each row. Version 2 (04 decision 51): M2 shows ApplicationUsage periods are whole hours, so they are summaries; a draft's time is not established as creation or last edit. A build job wrote these rows; no person has reviewed them yet.
